measurements.evidence_quote: The zeta potential values ranged from -47.9 mV to -25.2 mv (zeta potential absolute value ≥ 25 mV), indicating that the PS-MPs were stable and had larger zeta potentials in the medium, suggesting that they tend to aggregate in the medium (Table S2). || The particle size and zeta potential were determined using a nano laser particle sizer (Malvern, UK).
